Create Individual Isochrone Maps and Shapefiles

Source: R/create_individual_isochrone_plots.R
create_individual_isochrone_plots.Rd

This function creates individual Leaflet maps and shapefiles for specified drive times based on isochrone data.

Usage

create_individual_isochrone_plots(isochrones, drive_times)

Arguments

isochrones

An sf object containing isochrone data.

drive_times

A vector of unique drive times (in minutes) for which maps and shapefiles will be created.

Value

None. The function creates and saves individual maps and shapefiles.

See also

Other mapping: create_density_plot(), create_isochrones(), create_isochrones_for_dataframe(), create_line_plot(), create_scatter_plot(), map_create_acog_districts_sf(), map_create_base(), map_create_block_group_overlap(), map_create_leaflet_base(), map_create_physician_dot()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Load required libraries
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(mysterycall)

# Load isochrone data
isochrones <- readRDS("path_to_isochrones.rds")

# List of unique drive times for which you want to create plots and shapefiles
drive_times <- unique(isochrones$drive_time)

# Create individual isochrone maps and shapefiles
create_individual_isochrone_plots(isochrones, drive_times)
} # }
